topic: Your Smartphone Screen Steals Your Electrons
caption:
🧠 DID YOU KNOW? 🤯

Your smartphone screen isn't detecting pressure when you tap it. It's actually 'stealing' tiny bits of you to register your touch!

Here's the mind-blowing reality:
🔹 Your screen has an invisible electric grid, constantly sending out a small charge.
🔹 When your finger (a conductor) touches it, you absorb a tiny charge, completing a circuit.
🔹 That's why gloves don't work! They block the transfer of your electrons, leaving your screen clueless.
